InclusionRules.name: no Type 1 diabetes mellitus (DD-09), on or before index
InclusionRules.description: TAXIS rule-out from DD-09 'clinically confusable with': Type 2 diabetes mellitus -DD-09-> Type 1 diabetes mellitus without complication 4/4 G1 lift 119 [v60_ego1_c1] [direct] (Type 1 diabetes mellitus without complication is deprecated -> Maps to Type 1 diabetes mellitus); Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complication -DD-09-> Type 1 diabetes mellitus 4/4 G1 lift 67 [v60_ego1_c3] [symmetric: stored as Type 1 diabetes mellitus -> anchor]. TRADE-OFF: raises specificity by removing anyone coded Type 1 diabetes mellitus on or before index. Expected cost: ~3.1% of Type 2 diabetes mellitus patients also carry this code. Keep for 'clean' cases; drop, or lump the mimic into S1, if the two can legitimately coexist and the study wants every case.

InclusionRules.name: no Secondary diabetes mellitus (secondary form), on or before index
InclusionRules.description: Structural rule-out, secondary/induced form of the anchor: vocab: sibling of Type 2 diabetes mellitus under Diabetes mellitus, named as a secondary/induced form. TRADE-OFF: raises specificity by removing anyone coded Secondary diabetes mellitus on or before index. Expected cost unknown (source lacks co-occurrence counts). Keep for 'clean' cases; drop, or lump the mimic into S1, if the two can legitimately coexist and the study wants every case.

InclusionRules.name: has >=1 Type 2 diabetes mellitus dx within 0..+365d of index (route confirmer)
InclusionRules.description: Route confirmer: people who entered on a drug or lab (S2) must also carry the diagnosis within 365 days; people who entered on the diagnosis satisfy it at index. Window from temporal_policy (chronic), not from any KG edge.
